verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Carta's API/data platform covers cap tables, stakeholders, option grants, valuations, and even Investor/LLM plugins, but there is no mention anywhere of HRIS/payroll integrations (e.g., Gusto, Rippling) or automated sync of new hires/terminations into equity records. This is a plausible axis for an equity management platform, but no evidence supports it.
